initialJsGzipBytes.reason: Decision: retain the 512000 B total entry-plus-scene gzip ceiling while replacing Phaser. The Three.js WebGL2 spike measured 201792 B gzip including fixture inputs (renderer ADR); product bytes are measured by tools/scene-budget.mjs, not inferred from the spike.

assetBytes.reason: Decision: every reviewed atlas image and animation manifest served from assets/reviewed. 256 KiB is about nine times the first reviewed set (28 kB), room for the rest of the wave's art.

textureBytes.reason: Decision: retain 16 MiB. Account unique Texture identities across atlas, effects, reflections and generated RGBA8 labels (one shared atlas with per-mesh frame UVs), conservative full-resolution RGBA16F + depth/stencil renderer output, full-resolution PassNode RGBA16F + depth/stencil, BloomNode RGBA16F bright target and two five-level chains with floored dimensions. Source: three@0.187.0 Renderer._getFrameBufferTarget, PassNode and BloomNode.setSize. This bounds allocated storage, not driver residency. WebGPURenderer storage is keyed by Texture identity, not shared image Source (common/Textures.js and each backend texture utility).

firstSceneRenderMs.reason: The Web Vitals 'good' Largest Contentful Paint threshold (2.5 s), measured from renderer construction to the first drawn committed scene.

frameTimeMs.reason: Decision: retain the p95 unsmoothed requestAnimationFrame interval ceiling at the 30 fps laptop floor (Wave 4 section 9.3). This cadence check is distinct from GPU-complete pan latency: the #67 RTX 2060 SUPER high-tier Three.js WebGL2 spike measured p50/p95 1.8/2.0 ms at 960x540 DPR1; product timing is a post-merge maintainer step.

entityCount.reason: Decision: the most drawn entities one yard scene supports, about seventeen times the golden yard's fifteen.

patchApplicationMs.reason: Decision: the slowest committed snapshot or patch draw, half of a 60 frames per second frame so a commit never drops a frame on its own.

reconnectMs.reason: Decision: the first reconnect delay (SCENE_RECONNECT.firstDelayMs, 1 s, apps/web/src/projection.ts) plus 2 s for the join and snapshot, from the client observing its scene socket drop to the next ready scene.

referenceMeasurements.scope: Renderer bake-off spike; not measurements of the product adapter. Product GPU-complete pan timing remains the maintainer step after merge.

wsl2ChromiumAngleGlOverD3D12.caveat: Suspect-clock flag from failed peer candidates; maintainer reports real clock and working Three.js WebGL2.

productCorrectnessMeasurements.source: timeout 3600 taskset -c 0-3 pnpm run qualify:wave4; evidence/visual/captures.json (both SwiftShader backends, 36 tier comparisons)
productCorrectnessMeasurements.scope: Four-core software correctness and accounted allocation with one shared atlas Texture. GPU-complete latency remains the post-merge maintainer measurement; reference measurements above are from the bake-off spike.
